name: beyond_modify_processor_attributes
description: Batch modify processor attributes. Use attribute_ids with updates for selected attributes, processor_id plus from_io_type with updates.io_type to move all attributes from one processor IO port to another, or updates_by_attribute_id alone for per-attribute field changes such as assigning different logical names. When no explicit selection is supplied, its keys select the target attributes. Explicit attribute_ids or processor_id/from_io_type selections remain restrictive; update keys outside that selection are rejected. For pii_data_type and integer encryption_level, read beyond_get_usage_guide(workflow="attribute_security") or beyond_get_definitions(definition_names=["attribute_security_guide"]).

attribute_ids.description: Processor attribute IDs to update. If omitted, provide processor_id and from_io_type.

processor_id.description: Processor ID used to filter attributes, or required with from_io_type when attribute_ids is omitted.

from_io_type.description: Move all matching attributes from this IO type. Requires processor_id when attribute_ids is omitted.

data_type.description: Allowed physical type name. Updates the logical and physical types together in place, preserving attribute IDs and lineage. Scalar targets clear element metadata; changing a parent with nested children to a scalar is rejected.

nested_physical_data_type.description: Compatibility alias for nested_data_type; both supplied values must agree.

encryption_level.description: Integer levelNumber: 0=NONE (None), 1=MASKED (Masked), 2=ENCRYPTED (Encrypted), 3=HASHED (Hashed; one-way hash), 4=KEYSERVER (Key Server; encryption key managed by a key server). Writes do not accept null; omission preserves the value on modification.

io_type.description: Target IO type. For port moves, set this to the destination port, e.g. LOOKUP.

nested_data_type.description: Processor list/array element physical type from this storage type catalog, e.g. Object or String. Accepted on create/add/modify and returned on reads. nested_physical_data_type is an equivalent compatibility alias; if both are supplied they must agree. Null clears the element type.

pii_data_type.description: PII_DATA_TYPE enum name stored verbatim, e.g. DRIVER_LICENSE. Null clears the classification; this is independent of pii_level.

updates.description: Fields to apply to every matched processor attribute. Optional when updates_by_attribute_id is provided.

updates_by_attribute_id.description: Per-attribute updates keyed by attribute_id, e.g. {"attr_x": {"attribute_name": "대학교 코드"}}. Values are merged over common updates for that attribute.
